In Harbour CRM, your customers are called contacts. To add him:

1. Go to **Contacts**.
2. Select **New contact**.
3. Enter a **First name**. All other fields are optional.
4. Optionally add a **Last name**, **Email**, **Phone**, **Job title**, **Company** and **Status**.
5. Select **Save contact**.

The new contact opens straight away, so you can add a note about the quote he asked for.
